title: 2021 review: promoted, with three goals above expectations
summary: My manager wrote that I was deservedly promoted and was a steadying force while the team moved from a shift-left culture to continuous value delivery.
what_would_have_happened: Not applicable: a review, not an intervention.
the_call: Keep the software excellence programs delivering and help the team hold steady as it moved from a consulting brand to a contributor brand.
what_i_did: Led DevOps and BizDevOps assessment work, supported hiring, and took the software excellence programs beyond India to teams in the US and Brazil.
what_changed: Three goals were rated Exceeds Expectations, including changing how teams work and influencing company-level strategy, and my manager called the promotion deserved.

quotes.text: Datta has been a pivotal member of the SW CoE team for years and has been deservedly rewarded with a promotion this year.
He has also been a steadying force during significant transition of the team.
